Pleased to have been invited to speak at la Facultade de Filoloxía de la Universidade de Santiago de Compostela during my time as a visiting scholar with [BabelBrain: Mapping multilingual ecologies](https://gramatica.usc.es/en/projects/39). Join us at noon on June 17th for my talk about [experience-driven adaptation in the processing of Spanish-English code-switching](https://gramatica.usc.es/rails/active_--c2b738c89b2648141f082879d5fc1ede1311dde0/Conferencia_Treadway.png).
